pages.lesson:
LESSON: SARUFI 1.4.1 AINA ZA NOMINO PEKEE KAWAIDA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua nomino za pekee na za kawaida katika matini
2. kutambua aina za nomino za pekee katika matini
3. kutumia nomino za pekee na za kawaida ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua nomino za pekee na za kawaida katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua nomino za pekee na za kawaida katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua aina za nomino za pekee katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua aina za nomino za pekee katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia nomino za pekee na za kawaida ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia nomino za pekee na za kawaida ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida.
4. Show that you can: kutambua nomino za pekee na za kawaida katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 1.4.1 Aina za nomino pekee kawaida important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua nomino za pekee na za kawaida katika matini
2. kutambua aina za nomino za pekee katika matini
3. kutumia nomino za pekee na za kawaida ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
